source: Explicit user-provided website wording in the September 14, 2026 request. LaTeX arrows, dashes, itemize, and emphasis are rendered typographically; prose is unchanged.

recipe_intro.text: We compare an I2T-only baseline (R1) against five training recipes:

recipe_r1.text: R1: I2T only. Train only on I2T.

recipe_r2.text: R2: I2I → I2T. Pretrain on I2I while updating the shared understanding weights, then finetune on I2T.

recipe_r3.text: R3: Mixed → I2T. Jointly train on I2I and I2T, then finetune on I2T.

recipe_r4.text: R4: Frozen I2I → Mixed. Pretrain on I2I with the shared understanding weights frozen, then switch to mixed I2I–I2T training.

recipe_r5.text: R5: Mixed only. Jointly train on I2I and I2T throughout training.

recipe_r6.text: R6: I2I → Mixed. Pretrain on I2I while updating the shared understanding weights, then switch to mixed I2I–I2T training.

scaling_caption_web.text: (a) I2T evaluation accuracy as the amount of I2I training data increases across different training recipes on Jigsaw and Zoom-In, with the I2T data size held fixed as 1k. (b) I2T evaluation accuracy as the amount of I2T training data increases, comparing the I2T-only baseline with I2I training followed by I2T finetuning using 100k I2I samples.
